reuse.why: expectedAmount comes from the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts for the other schedule consumers.

duplication.why: No amount logic is written; the handler only adds one field.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler and typed in api-models; putting it in the scheduleModel would also have been reasonable, but keeping it list-only matches the request.

scope.why: Only the list handler, its type and a test change.

maintainability.why: A small additive change that relies on the single shared amount rule.
